name: Prone T-Raise
cues: Lie chest down on a bench set to a low incline
Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing up
Lift both arms wide until they form a T with your body
Draw your shoulder blades back as the arms rise

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-08 (bulk approval of wave 3a). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Same arc as 230 with elbow flexion 5. Palms face in at the hang (thorax-frame palm +x 0.98). At the top the grip axis points to the ceiling and the palm toward the head (rotation 0 to 75, pronation 0 to 80), so the thumbs-up T convention is clear and distinct from 230. Scapular retraction is the same 15 deg as 230, although this cue emphasises it. The 45 deg vs 'low incline' caveat applies.
